column1: # Written for this pack (GPL-3.0-or-later): hand decisions for measure.py's judge (--homographs), 533 words. For each, the lemmas a reader of ordinary prose needs.

# Round 1: the most frequent words whose wty-ar-en rows or clitic splits name several lemmas (top 250 of the subtitle frequency list and of the three texts). Round 2: the most frequent words wty-ar-en lists whose clitic splits name other lemmas (فلا, لك, به). Round 3: the words of the three texts that rule-made wrong results showed the judge got wrong (وعلى, فرأى, الان), and صوت with its pronouns, where صوة is also a word. README.md, Measurements.
